abstract: BACKGROUND: The residual mass so frequently found after chemotherapy of advanced seminoma may consist entirely of benign tissue or may contain residual disease amenable to adjuvant therapy. PATIENTS AND METHODS: A detailed retrospective analysis was performed on 45 patients treated with cisplatin based chemotherapy for advanced seminoma between 1978 and 1994. RESULTS: The probability of a residual mass after chemotherapy was higher if the pre-treatment mass diameter was > 5 cm (78% versus 15%, P = 0.0009). Of 33 patients with residual masses following cisplatin chemotherapy, 4 were explored surgically showing fibrosis only, 15 were treated by adjuvant radiotherapy and 14 were managed by observation alone. Recurrence occurred in 2 of 14 patients managed by observation and in 2 of 15 managed by radiotherapy. There was no evidence that risk of recurrence was related to diameter of residual mass. CONCLUSION: Residual masses persisted following cisplatin based combination chemotherapy for seminoma in 73% of cases. In our study, recurrence was rare and there was no evidence that this was influenced by either the size of the residual mass or the use of adjuvant therapy.
abstract_ja: 背景：進行セミノーマに対してシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った後に残る腫瘤は、大部分が良性組織からなる場合もあれば、補助療法の対象となる残存病変を含む場合もある。患者と方法：1978年から1994年までにシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた進行セミノーマ45例について後方視的解析を行った。結果：治療前の腫瘤径が5cmを超える場合、化学療法後に残存腫瘤が生じる割合が高かった（78%対15%、P=0.0009）。シスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存腫瘤を認めた33例のうち、4例は外科的に開腹探索を受け線維化のみを認め、15例は補助放射線療法を受け、14例は観察のみとした。再発は観察のみの14例中2例、放射線療法の15例中2例に認められた。再発リスクは残存腫瘤の大きさとは関連がなかった。結論：シスプラチン併用多剤化学療法後も残存腫瘤は、症例の73%で持続した。本研究では再発は稀であり、残存腫瘤の大きさや補助療法の使用によって影響を受けるという根拠はなかった。
